t: You're at the Sanderson Hotel on Berners Street, in Westminster. The building dates from 1958. It was designed by Reginald Uren, who was born in New Zealand and spent most of his career as an architect in the United Kingdom. He was a Fellow of the Royal Institute of British Architects. The hotel is a good example of his work from that period, and it stands as a reminder of how many architects came to London from across the Commonwealth.
